svg.title: 27 registered studies measure food noise; 1 has posted results
svg.desc: 27 ClinicalTrials.gov studies that name food noise or the Food Noise Questionnaire, pulled October 20, 2026: People already on approved GLP-1s: 13; New obesity drugs vs placebo: 8; Building the questionnaire: 3; Other, no GLP-1 drug: 3. 1 has posted results, a 2024 questionnaire-validation survey. 0 are randomized trials of Lilly or Novo Nordisk drugs. 17 were first posted in 2026.
